coupling: The segment-merging commit adds cleanup of the temporary private dictionary on a tag-read error before its then-fatal exit. The later size-check commit makes that read error a recoverable end of the segment run when prior segment data exists. Together, the recovery path retains a nonzero length after cleanup, publishes a null buffer as the private dictionary, and the subsequent decrypt/initialization writes through it. The repair has to reconcile ownership and partial-segment recovery across the two commits: either preserve the accumulated buffer on recovery or keep the error fatal after cleanup.
